models.label: Copilot 1.5B (tiny)
models.description: Smallest tier. Fast on 8 GB Macs. Lower recall on multi-step plans; reliable for simple navigate/scan/cluster requests.

models.label: Copilot 3B (light)
models.description: Comfortable on 16 GB Macs. Good middle ground for everyday workflows.

models.label: Copilot 3B q4 (light, quantized)
models.description: Int4 quantization of the 3B model. ~1.7 GB on disk, runs on 8 GB Macs comfortably.

models.label: Copilot 7B (balanced)
models.description: Default tier. Strong on multi-step composites and TSS-relative reasoning.

models.label: Copilot 7B q4 (quantized)
models.description: Int4 quantization of the 7B model. ~3.7x smaller (4 GB), runs on 8 GB Macs, accuracy on the failure-mode prompt is identical to fp16 in spot checks.

models.label: Copilot 14B (heavy)
models.description: Highest accuracy on long composite plans. Needs 32 GB+; comfortable on 64 GB.

models.label: Copilot 32B (max)
models.description: For 128 GB Mac Studio. Diminishing returns vs 14B for this dataset; useful for long custom api_call chains.
